Name: Rat's Vanilla Style Leo Redesign - Seasonal
Author: rathash3115
Description:
Hello helloooooooooooo!!!! :3

Even though Leo's my favorite character....... I gotta admit he looks really silly in his official arts xD

So this is my attempt at making him a wee bit cuter!!!!

I studied all the SDV arts, especially Jas and Vincent's, so he doesn't look out of place. Hopefully. Hehehehe

—

This is how the outfits should appear – please tell me if anything appears differently:

Spring: Spring outfit on the mainland, Spring outfit on Ginger Island

Summer, before his 6 heart event: Generic outfit (same outfit as Fall)

Summer, after his 6 heart event: Summer outfit on the mainland, Summer outfit on Ginger Island

Fall: Fall outfit on the mainland, Fall outfit on Ginger Island

Winter: Winter outfit on the mainland, Generic outfit on Ginger Island
